Alex G.: Heads-up — noticed a p99 spike on text-gen model `rwd-large-1` after merging #4721 (kernel selection tweak). p50 unchanged. Baseline p99 ~120ms -> now ~310ms for seq=1024, batch=1. Anyone else seeing this?
perf-bot: Canary perf summary for build 4721: model=rwd-large-1, seq=1024, batch=1 -> p50=22ms (+2ms), p95=85ms (+10ms), p99=310ms (+190ms). Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.example/canary/4721 :rotating_light:
Maria T.: Yup, alerted on SLOs. Looks correlated with the kernel chooser change that prefers `paged_path` for some seq lengths.
Jin L.: Started a quick git bisect across recent commits. Narrowed to commit 6c8a2ef which tweaked batching heuristics and the prefer-paged threshold. Repro locally with microbench. Command I used: `./bench/bench_attn --model=rwd-large-1 --seq=1024 --batch=1 --kernel=auto`
Alex G.: Can you post before/after numbers + a short profile?
Jin L.: Before (pre-4721): p99=118ms. After (post-4721): p99=312ms. p50 ~20ms -> 22ms. CPU sampling shows repeated kernel selection churn and extra device->host copies when KV hit rate is low. Flamegraph gist: https://gist.github.com/jin/ff7a2 (shows long tail in `select_kernel()` and `memcpy_async` blocks).
Maria T.: On prod traces I see a pattern: cold KV leads to fallback into paged path which has higher kernel startup cost. The chooser change seems to prefer paged when seq >= 512 even if KV hit ratio is high — likely a logic bug in the threshold check.
Sam R.: Quick mitigation test: forced kernel via env `KERNEL_PREF=fused_v2` on canary and p99 recovered to ~130ms. That suggests fused_v2 avoids the extra copies.
Alex G.: Good. Action items: 1) pin `fused_v2` for rwd-large-1 in prod config until we fix chooser, 2) open rollback PR for 6c8a2ef, 3) add unit+bench coverage simulating KV hit ratios. Who takes what?
Maria T.: I'll open the rollback PR and add a nightly bench that runs seq=512/1024 with simulated KV hit rates. Also setting an alert: p99 > 200ms for rwd-large-1.
Jin L.: I'll draft a minimal repro that toggles KV hit rate and the chooser logic; then propose a patch to respect `kv_hit_ratio` before switching to paged. Adding perf numbers and flamegraphs to issue #893. Example repro command: ```
# simulate low/higher KV hit
./bench/bench_attn --model=rwd-large-1 --seq=1024 --batch=1 --kv-hit=0.6
./bench/bench_attn --model=rwd-large-1 --seq=1024 --batch=1 --kv-hit=0.95
```
perf-bot: Git bisect finished. Culprit commit: 6c8a2ef (change in batching heuristics and kernel threshold). Revert on canary shows p99 back to ~125ms. Incident labeled sev=3 and linked: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2245
Alex G.: Thanks all. Two follow-ups: verify interplay with batching heuristics (I noticed max_batch_delay was reduced from 3ms -> 1ms in that commit which may increase small-batch churn and trigger more kernel switches), and verify memory-copy paths when KV hit is high.
Sam R.: Rolling config change to prefer `fused_v2` on canary now. Will monitor logs and SLOs. :thumbsup:
Maria T.: Adding regression test into CI and a guard in the chooser to require a clear KV-hit delta before preferring paged.
Jin L.: I'll post the minimal reproducer and a perf comparison table in the issue later today (p50/p95/p99 for fused_v2 vs paged vs auto).
Alex G.: Great. Keep this thread updated with PR numbers and canary metrics.
